exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.setup: Stand with your feet around shoulder-width apart and your toes turned slightly outward.
exercises.execution: Brace your trunk, sit your hips down between your feet, then press through your whole foot to stand tall.
exercises.safety: Keep your knees tracking in line with your toes and use only the depth you can control without losing balance.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Reverse Lunge
exercises.setup: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and enough clear space behind you.
exercises.execution: Step one foot back, lower both knees under control, then drive through the front foot to return to standing.
exercises.safety: Keep the front foot planted and shorten the step or range if you cannot maintain a steady position.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.setup: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat, and heels comfortably close to your hips.
exercises.execution: Brace your trunk and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips until your torso and thighs form a straight line, then lower with control.
exercises.safety: Finish the movement with your glutes rather than arching your lower back or pushing through your neck.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.setup: Place your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and form a straight line from head to heels.
exercises.execution: Lower your chest between your hands while keeping your body rigid, then press the floor away to return to the start.
exercises.safety: Keep your elbows at a comfortable angle from your torso and avoid letting your hips sag or your shoulders shrug.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Up
exercises.setup: Start on your hands and feet, then raise your hips so your torso angles downward toward your hands.
exercises.execution: Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor between your hands, then press back to the starting position.
exercises.safety: Use a stable hand position, move within a controlled range, and keep pressure away from the top of your head.

exercises.name: Front Plank
exercises.setup: Place your forearms on the floor with elbows beneath your shoulders and extend your legs behind you.
exercises.execution: Brace your abdomen and glutes while holding a straight line from your head through your heels.
exercises.safety: End the hold when you can no longer keep your hips and ribcage in a controlled position.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.setup: Lie on one side with your elbow beneath your shoulder and your legs extended or bent for support.
exercises.execution: Lift your hips and hold your body in a straight, stacked position while breathing steadily.
exercises.safety: Keep the supporting shoulder away from your ear and choose the leg position that lets you remain stable.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.setup: Stand tall with your feet around hip-width apart and use a stable support if needed for balance.
exercises.execution: Rise onto the balls of your feet, pause briefly at the top, and lower your heels under control.
exercises.safety: Keep your ankles tracking straight and avoid bouncing through the bottom of the movement.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
exercises.setup: Hold one dumbbell vertically close to your chest and stand with your feet around shoulder-width apart.
exercises.execution: Brace, squat down between your feet, and drive through your whole foot to stand while keeping the dumbbell close.
exercises.safety: Choose a load you can hold securely and keep your knees aligned with your toes throughout the repetition.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms long, knees softly bent, and feet around hip-width apart.
exercises.execution: Push your hips backward while the dumbbells travel close to your legs, then squeeze your glutes to return to standing.
exercises.safety: Keep your spine steady and stop the descent when further range would require your back to round.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.setup: Sit with the dumbbells on your thighs, guide them into position as you lie back, and plant your feet firmly.
exercises.execution: Lower the dumbbells to either side of your chest under control, then press them upward without colliding them.
exercises.safety: Keep your shoulders supported by the bench and use a controlled method to bring the dumbbells into and out of position.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Press
exercises.setup: Stand with a dumbbell at each shoulder, feet stable, and your trunk braced.
exercises.execution: Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are long, then lower them to your shoulders under control.
exercises.safety: Avoid leaning back to finish the press and keep the dumbbells moving through a path you can control.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.setup: Support yourself with one hand on a stable surface, hinge at the hips, and hold a dumbbell beneath the opposite shoulder.
exercises.execution: Pull the dumbbell toward your hip while keeping your torso steady, then lower until your arm is long.
exercises.safety: Keep your back in a controlled position and avoid twisting your torso to lift the load.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
exercises.setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, feet about hip-width apart, and clear space behind you.
exercises.execution: Step one foot back, lower both knees under control, and drive through the front foot to return to standing.
exercises.safety: Keep the dumbbells still at your sides and use a step length that allows the front foot to stay planted.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
exercises.setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides, and palms facing forward or slightly inward.
exercises.execution: Bend your elbows to raise the dumbbells without moving your upper arms forward, then lower them fully under control.
exercises.safety: Keep your torso still and reduce the load if you need momentum to complete the repetition.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.setup: Hold one dumbbell securely above your head with both hands and brace your trunk.
exercises.execution: Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell behind your head, then straighten your arms without moving your upper arms excessively.
exercises.safety: Use a load you can grip securely and keep the movement within a comfortable, controlled range.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Farmer Carry
exercises.setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell securely held at each side and a clear walking path ahead.
exercises.execution: Walk with controlled steps while keeping your torso tall, shoulders level, and the dumbbells quiet at your sides.
exercises.safety: Keep your route clear, turn deliberately, and end the carry before your grip or posture becomes unreliable.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.setup: Set the rack just below shoulder height, position the bar securely across your upper back, and step into a stable stance.
exercises.execution: Brace, squat down between your feet while keeping the bar balanced over mid-foot, then drive upward to stand.
exercises.safety: Set the rack safeties appropriately, secure the plates, and use a load and depth you can control throughout.

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.setup: Stand with the bar over mid-foot, hinge down to grip it outside your legs, and brace with your arms long.
exercises.execution: Push the floor away and extend your hips and knees together until standing, then return the bar under control.
exercises.safety: Keep the bar close, maintain a steady trunk position, and do not jerk the bar from the floor.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.setup: Lie with your eyes near the bar, plant your feet, set your upper back against the bench, and take an even grip.
exercises.execution: Unrack with control, lower the bar toward your lower chest, and press it back above your shoulders.
exercises.safety: Use secure collars and correctly positioned safeties or a capable spotter whenever the load could trap you.

exercises.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
exercises.setup: Hold the bar just outside your legs, hinge at the hips, and brace with the bar hanging beneath your shoulders.
exercises.execution: Pull the bar toward your lower ribs while keeping your torso steady, then lower it until your arms are long.
exercises.safety: Choose a torso angle and load you can maintain without rounding your back or using repeated body momentum.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
exercises.setup: Set the bar around upper-chest height, take an even grip, unrack it to your shoulders, and brace your trunk.
exercises.execution: Press the bar overhead while moving your head clear of its path, then lower it to your shoulders under control.
exercises.safety: Avoid leaning back to complete the lift and keep the bar path clear of your chin and face.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.setup: Place your upper back against a stable bench, position the padded bar across your hips, and plant your feet.
exercises.execution: Drive through your feet and extend your hips until your torso is level, then lower under control.
exercises.safety: Ensure the bench cannot slide, protect your hips with appropriate padding, and avoid finishing by overextending your lower back.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.setup: Secure your thighs beneath the pad, take an even overhead grip, and sit tall with your arms extended.
exercises.execution: Pull the bar toward your upper chest by driving your elbows down, then return it overhead under control.
exercises.safety: Keep your torso mostly steady and avoid pulling the bar behind your neck or letting the weight stack drop.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.setup: Sit with your feet supported, hold the attachment with long arms, and establish a tall, braced torso.
exercises.execution: Pull the handle toward your lower ribs while drawing your elbows back, then extend your arms under control.
exercises.safety: Avoid repeatedly rocking your torso to move the stack and keep the cable attachment secure.

exercises.name: Standing Cable Chest Press
exercises.setup: Set the handles around chest height, face away from the machine, and take a stable staggered stance.
exercises.execution: Press the handles forward until your arms are long, then let them return beside your chest under control.
exercises.safety: Keep your footing secure and do not let the cable load pull you backward between repetitions.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
exercises.setup: Set a rope attachment around face height, hold it with both hands, and step back into a balanced stance.
exercises.execution: Pull the rope toward your face while separating your hands and drawing your elbows back, then return slowly.
exercises.safety: Use a load that lets your shoulders move smoothly without leaning back or snapping the cable.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
exercises.setup: Set the cable high, hold the attachment with your elbows near your sides, and stand in a stable position.
exercises.execution: Straighten your elbows to move the attachment down, then return until your forearms rise without your upper arms drifting.
exercises.safety: Keep your wrists controlled and avoid using your body weight to force the attachment downward.

exercises.name: Cable Biceps Curl
exercises.setup: Set the cable low, hold the attachment with your arms extended, and stand tall with your elbows near your sides.
exercises.execution: Bend your elbows to curl the attachment upward, then lower it until your arms are long without losing cable tension.
exercises.safety: Keep your torso steady and maintain a secure grip as the attachment returns toward the stack.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Row
exercises.setup: Anchor the band securely around torso height, hold both ends, and step back until there is light tension.
exercises.execution: Pull your hands toward your lower ribs while keeping your torso still, then extend your arms slowly.
exercises.safety: Inspect the band and anchor before use and keep your face out of the band's direct line of recoil.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Chest Press
exercises.setup: Anchor the band securely behind you around chest height and take a stable staggered stance with a handle in each hand.
exercises.execution: Press your hands forward until your arms are long, then return them beside your chest under control.
exercises.safety: Inspect the band and anchor before use and avoid standing directly in the band's potential recoil path.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Pallof Press
exercises.setup: Anchor the band around chest height, stand side-on to the anchor, and hold the band against your chest.
exercises.execution: Press your hands straight forward without allowing your torso to rotate, then return them to your chest.
exercises.safety: Use a secure anchor and enough resistance to challenge control without pulling you off balance.

exercises.name: Treadmill Walking
exercises.setup: Stand on the stationary belt, attach the safety clip if provided, and begin at a slow speed.
exercises.execution: Walk with a natural stride and upright posture, adjusting speed or incline only when settled and balanced.
exercises.safety: Increase settings gradually, remain aware of the moving belt, and use the rails only briefly when regaining balance.

exercises.name: Stationary Cycling
exercises.setup: Adjust the seat so your knee remains slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke and secure your feet.
exercises.execution: Pedal smoothly at a sustainable cadence while keeping your hips stable and your upper body relaxed.
exercises.safety: Confirm all adjustments are locked before starting and change resistance gradually while maintaining control.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine
exercises.setup: Secure your feet, hold the handle evenly, and begin with bent knees, long arms, and a braced torso.
exercises.execution: Drive with your legs, then open your hips and draw the handle toward your lower ribs; reverse that sequence smoothly to return.
exercises.safety: Keep the chain level and controlled, avoid an exaggerated backward lean, and build pace only after establishing the sequence.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Step-Up
exercises.setup: Stand facing a stable bench or platform that lets you step up without needing to jump or push off the back foot.
exercises.execution: Place one whole foot on the platform, drive through that foot to stand tall, then step down under control and repeat on both sides.
exercises.safety: Use a stable, non-slip surface and choose a height that lets you keep the working knee and foot controlled.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Split Squat
exercises.setup: Stand in a staggered stance with both feet pointing forward and enough space between them to lower comfortably.
exercises.execution: Lower your back knee toward the floor while keeping your torso steady, then press through the front foot to return to the start.
exercises.safety: Keep the front foot fully planted and shorten the stance or range if you lose balance or knee control.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
exercises.setup: Place your hands on a stable elevated surface and walk your feet back until your body forms a straight line.
exercises.execution: Lower your chest toward the surface with control, then press the surface away to return to the starting position.
exercises.safety: Use a surface that cannot slide or tip, and keep your body aligned rather than letting your hips sag.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.setup: Lie on your back with your arms pointed toward the ceiling and your hips and knees bent to about 90 degrees.
exercises.execution: Brace your abdomen as you slowly extend one leg and the opposite arm, then return them and alternate sides.
exercises.safety: Use only the range that lets your lower back remain comfortably controlled against the floor.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.setup: Start on hands and knees with your hands beneath your shoulders and knees beneath your hips.
exercises.execution: Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back while keeping your torso still, then return and alternate sides.
exercises.safety: Keep the movement slow and controlled; reduce the reach if your back rotates or your balance becomes unsteady.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Split Squat
exercises.setup: Stand in a stable staggered stance while holding dumbbells at your sides with your arms long.
exercises.execution: Lower your back knee toward the floor under control, then press through the front foot to stand without changing your stance.
exercises.safety: Choose a load that lets you maintain balance and keep the front knee tracking with the foot.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.setup: Lie on the floor holding dumbbells above your chest with knees bent and feet planted.
exercises.execution: Lower the dumbbells until your upper arms lightly contact the floor, then press them back above your chest with control.
exercises.safety: Keep your wrists stacked over your forearms and lower both dumbbells evenly rather than bouncing off the floor.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Chest-Supported Row
exercises.setup: Set a stable bench to a comfortable incline, rest your chest against it, and let the dumbbells hang beneath your shoulders.
exercises.execution: Pull the dumbbells toward your lower ribs while keeping your chest supported, then lower them slowly to a long-arm position.
exercises.safety: Confirm the bench is secure and keep your neck relaxed rather than lifting your head to force the range.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
exercises.setup: Set a stable bench to a modest incline and lie back holding dumbbells above your upper chest with feet planted.
exercises.execution: Lower the dumbbells evenly beside your upper chest, then press them upward until your arms are long without locking out forcefully.
exercises.safety: Set the bench securely and use a load that lets you control both dumbbells without losing shoulder or wrist position.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
exercises.setup: Stand with dumbbells at your sides and palms facing one another throughout the movement.
exercises.execution: Bend your elbows to raise the dumbbells toward your shoulders, then lower them until your arms are long again.
exercises.safety: Keep your upper arms close to your sides and avoid rocking your torso to move the weight.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
exercises.setup: Hinge forward with a neutral spine, hold a dumbbell, and position your upper arm alongside your torso.
exercises.execution: Keep the upper arm still as you straighten the elbow behind you, then return the dumbbell under control.
exercises.safety: Use a light load and keep your torso stable; do not force the elbow past a controlled straight position.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Suitcase Carry
exercises.setup: Stand tall holding one dumbbell at your side with a clear, level route in front of you.
exercises.execution: Walk at a controlled pace while keeping your torso upright, then change hands and repeat the planned distance.
exercises.safety: Keep the route clear and choose a load that does not pull you into a side bend or compromise your grip.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
exercises.setup: Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand facing a stable bench or platform that you can step onto without jumping.
exercises.execution: Place one whole foot on the platform, stand by driving through that foot, then step down slowly and repeat on both sides.
exercises.safety: Use a lower platform or lighter dumbbells if you cannot maintain balance and a controlled descent.

exercises.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.setup: Stand tall holding a barbell against your thighs with feet about hip-width apart and a braced torso.
exercises.execution: Push your hips back as the bar travels close to your legs, then drive your hips forward to stand tall again.
exercises.safety: Keep the bar close and stop the descent when you cannot maintain a controlled hip hinge and steady back position.

exercises.name: Barbell Floor Press
exercises.setup: Set the barbell on a stable rack height above the floor position, then lie beneath it with your feet planted and hands even on the bar.
exercises.execution: Unrack with control, lower the bar until your upper arms contact the floor, then press it back to the rack height.
exercises.safety: Use safety supports or a spotter when appropriate, and confirm the bar can be reracked without reaching or twisting.

exercises.name: Barbell Reverse Lunge
exercises.setup: Unrack a barbell onto your upper back from a stable rack and stand clear with feet about hip-width apart.
exercises.execution: Step one foot back, lower both knees with control, then drive through the front foot to return to standing before alternating sides.
exercises.safety: Use a load and range that let you step and rerack steadily; stop if you cannot keep your balance under the bar.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
exercises.setup: Set a cable low with a rope attachment, face away from the machine, and stand far enough forward for cable tension.
exercises.execution: Hinge your hips back as the rope passes between your legs, then drive your hips forward to stand tall.
exercises.safety: Check the attachment and cable path first, and keep the movement a controlled hip hinge rather than a squat or back extension.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Row
exercises.setup: Set a cable around lower-rib height, stand in a stable staggered stance, and hold one handle with your arm extended.
exercises.execution: Pull the handle toward your lower ribs while keeping your torso steady, then extend your arm slowly to the start.
exercises.safety: Keep the cable path clear and use a resistance that does not pull you into rotation or a loss of balance.

exercises.name: Cable Reverse Fly
exercises.setup: Set the pulleys around shoulder height, take the opposite handle in each hand, and stand tall with a soft bend in your elbows.
exercises.execution: Open your arms out to the sides until your hands move in line with your torso, then return them under control.
exercises.safety: Keep the resistance light enough to avoid shrugging or forcefully pulling the shoulders backward.

exercises.name: Cable Straight-Arm Pulldown
exercises.setup: Set a straight bar or rope above head height, step back slightly, and hold the attachment with mostly straight arms.
exercises.execution: Pull the attachment down toward your thighs while keeping your torso steady, then return it slowly to the starting position.
exercises.safety: Choose a resistance that lets you control the return without leaning or arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Pull-Apart
exercises.setup: Stand tall holding a light resistance band at shoulder height with arms extended in front of you.
exercises.execution: Pull your hands apart until the band reaches your chest, then bring your hands back together with control.
exercises.safety: Inspect the band for damage and use a tension that lets you avoid shrugging or snapping the band back.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Lat Pulldown
exercises.setup: Anchor a band securely above head height and stand or kneel far enough away to begin with your arms long.
exercises.execution: Draw your elbows down toward your sides, then let the band return your arms upward under control.
exercises.safety: Check the anchor and band before every set, and keep your face outside the band's possible recoil path.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Biceps Curl
exercises.setup: Stand on the middle of a resistance band with feet stable and hold one end in each hand with arms at your sides.
exercises.execution: Bend your elbows to bring your hands toward your shoulders, then lower them slowly until your arms are long.
exercises.safety: Keep both feet firmly on the band and inspect it for wear before applying tension.

exercises.name: Treadmill Running
exercises.setup: Stand on the stationary belt, attach the safety clip if provided, and start at a pace you can settle into safely.
exercises.execution: Run with a relaxed, upright posture and controlled foot placement while adjusting speed or incline only after you are stable.
exercises.safety: Increase settings gradually, stay aware of the moving belt, and step to the side rails before stopping the machine.

exercises.name: Elliptical Trainer
exercises.setup: Step onto the stationary pedals, take the handles if available, and begin at a low resistance while standing upright.
exercises.execution: Move the pedals smoothly through their full path while keeping your torso steady and your grip relaxed.
exercises.safety: Confirm the pedals are stationary before stepping on or off, and adjust resistance gradually while maintaining balance.
